title: Towards a modular architecture for science factories (WEI; color-picker + PCR workcells)
results_evidence: Executed closed-loop color-matching and PCR workflows on the ANL RPL workcell with reported timing/throughput and color-error convergence.
simulatable: true: built-in simulate_interface lets YAML workflows run with no hardware
readiness_reason: Open paper, MIT code, YAML workflow + module specs run in simulate mode; tasks can be 'methods -> WEI workflow YAML' graded against module/action sequence.

title: MADSci: A modular Python-based framework to enable autonomous science
results_evidence: Framework; experiments reported via ANL RPL deployments but no single peer-reviewed results paper verified.
simulatable: true: example_lab ships virtual example modules via docker compose
readiness_reason: JOSS software paper (no wet-lab results paper of its own); simulatable example lab makes it a good execution substrate for WEI/RPL-derived tasks.

title: AD-SDL PF400 / PlateCrane / Sciclops module drivers (WEI workcell modules)
results_evidence: Same experiments as WEI paper (plate moves between OT-2, sealer, thermocycler, camera).
simulatable: partial: TCP drivers need hardware; must be stubbed (WEI simulate mode bypasses them)
readiness_reason: Overlaps glas-preciseflex style PF400 control; low-level TCP command strings need a mock server for grading.

title: Autonomous platform for solution processing of electronic polymers (Polybot)
results_evidence: Autonomously optimised PEDOT:PSS film conductivity/defects over closed-loop campaigns; conductivities reported.
simulatable: false: only analysis notebooks released; orchestration code not public
readiness_reason: Results + data public but robot orchestration (Polybot/WEI) not released for this paper.

title: ChemOS: An orchestration software to democratize autonomous discovery
results_evidence: Demonstrates closed-loop optimisation on a cocktail-mixing robot and HPLC calibration, with reported optimisation traces.
simulatable: partial: dummy experiment folders; py2-era code, needs revival
readiness_reason: Old code (pyc, Python2-era); grading via dummy instrument possible but setup heavy.

title: Atlas: a brain for self-driving laboratories (BO library used in ChemOS 2.0 campaigns)
results_evidence: BO planners benchmarked on emulators and deployed on SDL campaigns (e.g., electrochemistry with ChemOS 2.0).
simulatable: true: pure software, Olympus emulators
readiness_reason: Planner library only; hardware-free but task would be optimisation config, not lab-automation code.

title: BayBE: Bayesian Back End for design of experiments
results_evidence: Campaign API with benchmarks; industrial case studies reported, few with released wet-lab data.
simulatable: true: pure software
readiness_reason: Not hardware-automation code; only adjunct planner.

title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models (Coscientist)
results_evidence: Suzuki/Sonogashira couplings executed and confirmed by GC-MS; plate-reader colour tasks executed.
simulatable: partial: OT-2 simulate for LH parts; ECL SLL steps not simulatable
readiness_reason: Heavily overlaps LH (OT-2); non-LH element is ECL cloud-lab and plate-reader calls; released code is a reduced implementation.

title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools (ChemCrow)
results_evidence: Executed syntheses of DEET and three thioureas plus a chromophore on RoboRXN, with characterisation.
simulatable: false: RoboRXN cloud API required (no simulator)
readiness_reason: Execution is via proprietary cloud API; could grade generated RXN action sequences offline.

title: Large language models for chemistry robotics (CLAIRify: NL -> XDL)
results_evidence: Generated XDL executed on a Franka robot for solubility/recrystallisation; expert-evaluated XDL validity on 108 protocols.
simulatable: true: XDL verifier (syntax/static checks) runs offline; robot execution via simulation
readiness_reason: Directly a 'methods text -> XDL' task with a bundled verifier and ~100 protocol texts; MIT.

title: ORGANA: a robotic assistant for automated chemistry experimentation and characterization
results_evidence: Solubility, pH, recrystallisation and electrochemistry (quinone) experiments executed with reported user-study times and measured values.
simulatable: partial: XDL plans + PDDLStream/MoveIt planning simulatable
readiness_reason: No licence on repo; XDL plans gradeable, robot layer needs ROS/MoveIt.

title: Verification and execution of the scientific literature via chemputation augmented by large language models
results_evidence: LLM-generated XDL from literature procedures executed on the Chemputer with yields reported; >100 reference XDLs released.
simulatable: true: chemputer XDL compiles/simulates against a graph (xdl dry-run)
readiness_reason: Ready-made literature->XDL pairs with executed results; check licence text before vendoring.

title: Reaction blueprints and logical control flow for parallelized chiral synthesis in the Chemputer
results_evidence: Parallel chiral syntheses executed with reported yields/ee using XDL blueprints.
simulatable: true: XDL 2.0 compile + simulate mode
readiness_reason: XDL procedures in SI map to methods text; xdl package supports simulation without hardware.

title: Universal peptide synthesis via solid-phase methods fused with chemputation
results_evidence: Synthesised multiple peptides (incl. semaglutide-type) with purity/yield reported.
simulatable: true: XDL simulation
readiness_reason: XDL in Zenodo + methods text; good protocol_language tasks.

title: Robotic Modules for the Programmable Chemputation of Molecules and Materials
results_evidence: Several syntheses executed on new modules with yields reported.
simulatable: true: XDL simulation
readiness_reason: Code link not in full text; relies on SI.

title: Autonomous mobile robots for exploratory synthetic chemistry
code_files: Zenodo: workflow + decision-maker code, Chemspeed scripts, robot ROS code (several records)
results_evidence: Supramolecular/structural diversification chemistry run autonomously with UPLC-MS/NMR-based decisions; hits reported.
simulatable: partial: decision-maker runs on released data; robot/ROS code needs hardware or Gazebo stub
readiness_reason: Strong triple; Zenodo code bundle sizeable; grading via decision logic or workflow script structure.

title: Precise, automated control of conditions for high-throughput growth of yeast and bacteria with eVOLVER
results_evidence: Turbidostat/chemostat growth curves and selection experiments across 16 vials reported with fitness measurements.

readiness_reason: MIT; turbidostat/chemostat control functions are small and gradeable by replaying OD traces to check pump commands; paper PDF is PMC author manuscript.

title: Environmental fluctuations reshape an unexpected diversity-disturbance relationship in a microbial community (eVOLVER)
results_evidence: Fluctuating dilution regimes run on eVOLVER with community composition measured by sequencing.

title: In situ characterisation and manipulation of biological systems with Chi.Bio

readiness_reason: No licence on code; single large app.py; otherwise excellent methods->control-program tasks.

title: Dynamic cybergenetic control of bacterial co-culture composition via optogenetic feedback
results_evidence: Closed-loop optogenetic control held E. coli co-culture ratios at setpoints over days; measured composition reported.
simulatable: partial: controller logic simulatable with a growth model; firmware needs hardware
readiness_reason: No licence; mixed Arduino/Python; controller logic good grading target.

venue: software (no primary paper; cited in e.g. Microb Cell Fact 2025, Nature 2026)

title: BIO-SPEC: An open-source bench-top parallel bioreactor system
